# Oonique Event Marketing

> Event marketing consultancy run by Oonagh Hughes. Oonique helps event teams find out what is holding their registrations and attendance back, and fix it. Oonagh led registration marketing for Cvent CONNECT Europe, Cvent's flagship European user conference, from 2023 to 2026.

Contact: hello@oonique-marketing.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/oonagh-hughes/ · Book a call: https://oonique-marketing.com/contact

## Pages

- [Home](https://oonique-marketing.com/): overview, results by year at Cvent CONNECT Europe, and services
- [Services](https://oonique-marketing.com/services): event marketing audit; registration strategy; attendance and show-rate strategy; messaging and positioning; hands-on delivery
- [Case studies](https://oonique-marketing.com/case-studies): segmented messaging (+148% email-driven registrations, 2025); cutting free passes (show rate 64% to 73%, registration revenue +27%, 2026)
- [About](https://oonique-marketing.com/about): Oonagh Hughes's background, speaking and testimonials
- [Contact](https://oonique-marketing.com/contact): enquiry form

## Key results at Cvent CONNECT Europe

- 2026 (Rethinking free passes): 73% in-person show rate, up from 64%; +27% registration revenue, with the room just as full; 152% of the marketing-driven in-person registration goal
- 2025 (A new tone of voice): +148% email-driven registrations; +21% marketing-driven in-person registrations, against 17% growth for the event overall
- 2024 (Marketing-led registrations): 60% of all registrations came through marketing, a share held every year since; +163% organic social engagement year-on-year, with video views up 203%
- 2023 (Bringing people back): 1,248 in-person attendees, the largest CONNECT Europe ever; +39% in-person registrations, from 1,230 to 1,704
